yvowels.title: Y-unlilar
yvowels.concept: Qisqa chiziq qo‘shilsa **y** tovushi hosil bo‘ladi: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) va ㅔ (e) zamonaviy koreys tilida deyarli bir xil eshitiladi.

consonants2.title: Yana undoshlar
consonants2.concept: ㄹ “r” va “l” oralig‘idagi tovush. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, havo bilan), ㅋ (k, havo bilan), ㅌ (t, havo bilan) va ㅍ (p, havo bilan) asosiy undoshlarni to‘ldiradi.

doubled.title: Qo‘sh undoshlar
doubled.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ va ㅉ — qattiq tovushlar: ularni bo‘g‘izni tarang qilib, havo chiqarmasdan ayting, xuddi inglizcha “skate” so‘zining birinchi tovushi kabi.

batchim.title: Oxirgi undoshlar
batchim.concept: Bo‘g‘in ostidagi undosh **받침 (batchim)** deyiladi. U bo‘g‘inni yopadi: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Oxirida faqat yettita tovush bo‘lishi mumkin: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.

words2.title: Kundalik so‘zlar
words2.concept: Har bir so‘zni bo‘g‘inma-bo‘g‘in o‘qing. 학교 “hakgyo” deb o‘qiladi: 학 dagi oxirgi ㄱ yopiq bo‘ladi va keyingi bo‘g‘in qattiq aytiladi.

words3.title: Dunyo haqidagi so‘zlar
words3.concept: Odamlar va tabiat: 사람 (odam), 나라 (mamlakat), 하늘 (osmon), 산 (tog‘), 강 (daryo), 꽃 (gul).

manners.title: Hurmatli iboralar
manners.concept: Kimningdir e’tiborini tortish yoki yo‘l so‘rash uchun 실례합니다, do‘stona rahmat aytish uchun 고마워요, rahmatga javob berish uchun 천만에요, tabriklash uchun 축하해요 deyiladi.

introduce.title: Ismlar va mamlakatlar
introduce.concept: Ismni 이름이 뭐예요? bilan, mamlakatni 어느 나라 사람이에요? bilan so‘rang. Javobni 제 이름은 ___예요 yoki 저는 ___ 사람이에요 bilan bering.

partings.title: Xayrlashish
partings.concept: Do‘stlar o‘rtasida 잘 가요 (xayr), 내일 봐요 (ertagacha), 또 만나요 (yana ko‘rishamiz) va 잘 자요 (xayrli tun) deyish mumkin.

wellbeing.title: Ahvolingiz qalay?
wellbeing.concept: 잘 지냈어요? (Yaxshi yurdingizmi?) deb so‘rang va 잘 지내요 (yaxshiman) deb javob bering. 좋은 아침이에요 “Xayrli tong.” degani.

helpme.title: Yordam so‘rash
helpme.concept: Yordam so‘rash uchun 도와주세요, bilmasangiz 모르겠어요, tushunsangiz 알겠어요, qayta aytishni so‘rash uchun 다시 말해 주세요 deng.

opinions.title: Yoqtirish va javoblar
opinions.concept: 좋아요 yaxshi yoki bo‘ladi degani, 싫어요 yoqmaydi degani, 맞아요 “to‘g‘ri” va 틀려요 “noto‘g‘ri” degani.

native10.title: Sof koreys sonlari 6–10
native10.concept: Sof koreys sonlarini davom ettiring: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).

sino.title: Xitoy-koreys sonlari
sino.concept: Xitoy-koreys sonlari: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Ular pul, sana, telefon raqami va daqiqalar uchun ishlatiladi.

ages.title: Yosh
ages.concept: 몇 살이에요? (Necha yoshdasiz?) deb so‘rang. Yosh sof koreys sonlari va 살 bilan aytiladi: 열 살 (10 yosh), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).

family2.title: Oila haqida yana so‘zlar
family2.concept: Aka-uka va opa-singillar so‘zlovchiga qarab turlicha ataladi: ayol 오빠 (aka) va 언니 (opa) deydi. Shuningdek 아들 (o‘g‘il), 딸 (qiz), 부모님 (ota-ona).

ourfamily.title: Bizning oila
ourfamily.concept: Koreyslar ko‘pincha “mening” o‘rniga 우리 (biz, bizning) deydi: 우리 가족 “mening oilam” degani. Odamlarni 명 bilan sanang: 네 명 (to‘rt kishi).

food.title: Ovqat va ichimlik
food.concept: 밥 (guruch, ovqat), 빵 (non), 과일 (meva), 고기 (go‘sht), 물 (suv), 우유 (sut).

likes.title: Yoqtirish va yoqtirmaslik
likes.concept: Nimani yoqtirishingizni -를/을 좋아해요 bilan, yoqtirmasligingizni -를/을 싫어해요 bilan ayting: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

adjectives.title: Narsalarni tasvirlash
adjectives.concept: Tasvirlovchi so‘zlar ham -요 bilan tugaydi: 커요 (katta), 작아요 (kichik), 많아요 (ko‘p), 맛있어요 (mazali), 예뻐요 (chiroyli).

weather.title: Ob-havo
weather.concept: 날씨 (ob-havo), 더워요 (issiq), 추워요 (sovuq), 비가 와요 (yomg‘ir yog‘yapti), 눈이 와요 (qor yog‘yapti).

negation.title: 안 va 못 bilan inkor
negation.concept: Fe’l oldiga **안** qo‘ysangiz, biror ishni qilmasligingizni bildirasiz (안 가요). **못** qo‘ysangiz, qila olmasligingizni bildirasiz (못 가요).

daily.title: Kundalik tartib
daily.concept: 일어나요 (uyg‘onaman), 씻어요 (yuvinaman), 일해요 (ishlayman), 자요 (uxlayman). 아침 (ertalab) va 밤 (tun) kabi vaqt so‘zlariga 에 qo‘shiladi: 아침에.

weekdays.title: Hafta kunlari
weekdays.concept: 월요일 (dushanba), 화요일 (seshanba), 수요일 (chorshanba), 목요일 (payshanba), 금요일 (juma), 토요일 (shanba), 일요일 (yakshanba).

months.title: Oylar
months.concept: Oylar xitoy-koreys son va 월 dan iborat: 일월 (yanvar), 삼월 (mart), 오월 (may), 칠월 (iyul), 구월 (sentabr), 십이월 (dekabr).

clock.title: Soatni aytish
clock.concept: Soatlar sof koreys sonlari va 시 bilan aytiladi: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). 몇 시예요? deb so‘rang.

frequency.title: Qanchalik tez-tez
frequency.concept: 매일 (har kuni), 자주 (tez-tez), 가끔 (ba’zan), 항상 (doim). Ularni fe’l oldiga qo‘ying.

past2.title: O‘tgan zamon haqida yana
past2.concept: O‘tgan zamon qo‘shimchasi -았/었어요: 했어요 (qildim), 왔어요 (keldim), 만났어요 (uchrashdim), 샀어요 (sotib oldim), 잤어요 (uxladim).

birthday.title: Tug‘ilgan kun va dam olish kunlari
birthday.concept: 생일 (tug‘ilgan kun), 주말 (dam olish kunlari), 선물 (sovg‘a). 생일이 언제예요? deb so‘rang va 제 생일은 오월이에요 deb javob bering.

restaurant.title: Restoranda
restaurant.concept: 메뉴 (menyu), 주문할게요 (buyurtma beraman), 물 더 주세요 (yana suv bering), 계산해 주세요 (hisobni keltiring).

transport.title: Yurish-turish
transport.concept: 버스 (avtobus), 지하철 (metro), 택시 (taksi), 기차 (poyezd). Nima bilan borishni -로/으로 bilan ayting: 버스로 가요.

phone.title: Telefon qo‘ng‘iroqlari va xabarlar
phone.concept: 전화 (telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i), 전화번호 (telefon raqami), 문자 (matnli xabar). 전화해요 “qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman” degani.

hospital.title: Kasalxonada
hospital.concept: 병원 (kasalxona), 약 (dori), 아파요 (og‘riyapti). Avval tana a’zosini ayting: 머리가 아파요 (boshim og‘riyapti).

requests.title: Hurmatli iltimoslar
requests.concept: -세요 va -아/어 주세요 hurmatli iltimos hosil qiladi: 앉으세요 (o‘tiring), 기다려 주세요 (kuting), 문을 열어 주세요 (eshikni oching).

invitations.title: Birgalikda reja qilish
invitations.concept: 같이 (birga) taklif bildiradi: 같이 가요. 갈래요? “Borasizmi?” deb, 시간 있어요? “Vaqtingiz bormi?” deb so‘raydi.

signs.title: Siz ko‘radigan belgilar
signs.concept: Koreyada hamma joyda qisqa belgilar bor. **입구** — kirish, **출구** — chiqish, **화장실** — hojatxona. Eshiklarda **미세요** “itaring”, **당기세요** “torting” degani.

culture.title: Taom uchun rahmat
culture.concept: Ovqatdan oldin **잘 먹겠습니다**, ovqatdan keyin **잘 먹었습니다** deyiladi. Mezbon mehmonni **어서 오세요** deb kutib oladi, **맛있어요** esa taomni maqtashdir.

messages.title: Do‘stga xabar yozish
messages.concept: Xabarlarda **-요** bilan tugaydigan qisqa, odobli gaplar ishlatiladi. **지금 어디예요?** — “Hozir qayerdasiz?”, **곧 가요** — “Tez orada yetib boraman”, **늦어요** — “Kechikaman”.

sounds.title: So‘zlarni ovoz chiqarib o‘qish
sounds.concept: Bo‘g‘in undosh bilan tugab, keyingisi unli bilan boshlansa, tovush oldinga o‘tadi: 책이 **chaegi**, 밥을 **babeul** deb o‘qiladi. Ba’zi tovushlar qo‘shni tovushni ham o‘zgartiradi: 국물 **gungmul**, 같이 **gachi** deb o‘qiladi.

indirect_state.title: Indirect statements (-다고 하다)
indirect_state.concept: Report what someone says or said: verb/adj + -다고 하다.

indirect_cmd.title: Indirect commands and suggestions (-라고 / -자고 하다)
indirect_cmd.concept: Report an imperative (-라고 하다) or propositive (-자고 하다).

cause_contrast.title: Complex causes and contrasts (-느라고, -는데도)
cause_contrast.concept: Negative cause or delay (-느라고) and contrast despite circumstances (-는데도).

proportion.title: Proportion and inevitability (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
proportion.concept: The more... the more (-을수록) and natural inevitability (-기 마련이다).

appearance.title: Appearance and inference (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
appearance.concept: Looks like (-아/어 보이다) and appears to be (-는 모양이다).

pretense.title: Pretending (-는 척하다)
pretense.concept: Pretend to do or be something: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.

regret.title: Regret and counterfactuals (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
regret.concept: Express regret: 'I should have done...' -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요.

review_k7.title: K7 Comprehensive Review
review_k7.concept: Review indirect speech, complex connectors and nuanced expressions.

honorific_subj.title: Honorific vocabulary for subjects
honorific_subj.concept: Special honorific nouns and verbs for revered people: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.

honorific_obj.title: Object honorific verbs (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
honorific_obj.concept: Humble/honorific verbs when the action is directed toward an elder: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.

passive_affix.title: Affix passives (-이/히/리/기-)
passive_affix.concept: Passive verbs formed by adding -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.

passive_compound.title: Syntactic passives (-어지다, -게 되다)
passive_compound.concept: Verbs taking spontaneous or resulting passive forms: -아/어지다, -게 되다.

causative_affix.title: Affix causatives (-이/히/리/기/우-)
causative_affix.concept: Causative verbs that make someone do an action: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.

causative_compound.title: Syntactic causatives (-게 하다)
causative_compound.concept: Make or cause someone to do something: -게 하다.

formal_style.title: Public formal style (-하십시오)
formal_style.concept: High formal deferential style for announcements and ceremonies: -하십시오, -하십시다.

modesty.title: Modest and humble expressions
modesty.concept: Polite speech using humble pronouns and verbs: 저희, 말씀 올리다.

review_k8.title: K8 Comprehensive Review
review_k8.concept: Review honorifics, passive, causative and formal polite registers.

biz_email.title: Business email writing and requests
biz_email.concept: Formal business email conventions: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.

biz_phone.title: Business telephone etiquette
biz_phone.concept: Handling calls and messages: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.

biz_schedule.title: Scheduling and rescheduling
biz_schedule.concept: Proposing and changing appointment times: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.

biz_meeting.title: Meeting discussions and opinions
biz_meeting.concept: Expressing views during meetings: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.

biz_report.title: Reporting project progress
biz_report.concept: Giving status updates: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.

biz_stats.title: Statistical figures and data trends
biz_stats.concept: Describing trends and numbers: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.

biz_negotiate.title: Business negotiations and partnerships
biz_negotiate.concept: Professional collaboration: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.

biz_etiquette.title: Business cards and professional titles
biz_etiquette.concept: Exchanging cards and titles: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.

review_k9.title: K9 Comprehensive Review
review_k9.concept: Review professional communications, formal correspondence and meetings.

media_headline.title: Headlines and compressed style
media_headline.concept: News headlines and compressed noun phrases: 물가 안정 대책 발표.

media_article.title: Current affairs and editorials
media_article.concept: Reading short news articles: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.

idioms_body.title: Body-part idioms (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
idioms_body.concept: Common idioms with body parts: 발이 넓다 (wide network), 눈이 높다 (high standards).

idioms_action.title: Everyday action idioms (바가지, 어깨)
idioms_action.concept: Expressions for common situations: 바가지를 쓰다 (ripped off), 어깨가 무겁다 (heavy duty).

proverbs_life.title: Essential Korean proverbs
proverbs_life.concept: Wisdom in proverbs: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.

sino_four.title: Four-character idioms (사자성어)
sino_four.concept: Common four-character Chinese-derived idioms: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.

logic_debate.title: Logical connectors and discourse markers
logic_debate.concept: Formal discourse markers: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.

culture_deep.title: Deep Korean cultural values and customs
culture_deep.concept: Cultural concepts and holiday traditions: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.

review_k10.title: K10 Comprehensive Review
review_k10.concept: Mastery of Korean culture, media, idioms and formal debate expressions.

note.native: Sof koreys sonlari (하나, 둘, 셋 …) narsalarni sanash va soatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
